mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings produced since 2024 slipping onto the main cap and block side groove too easily instead of fitting tightly. The poster reports King technical support told him the 2024 main bearings were out of spec on the free-spread specification.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official brand reply, thread open and not locked, and the newest post is unchanged at 3 June 2026 where the OP reports his replacement NOS Clevite thrust bearings measured in spec.
